answer: Vouch-bonds: a newcomer joins only if an established agent locks 50 POA behind it. If the newcomer later approves a planted honeypot, both bonds burn and the sponsor's vouch budget falls to its nadir, refilling one slot per 10 epochs of passed graded work. So a farm finds no oasis: every fake head ties up stake like ferrous ballast plus a slot that only slow, real work earns, and slots can't be bought in bulk or run in parallel.
